title: Sweet Princess Dress-Up
description: Style adorable anime princesses with hundreds of hairstyles, sparkling gowns, ribbons, and pastel accessories to win dazzling fashion showdowns.
controls: Tap wardrobe tabs to mix and match hairstyles, dresses, shoes, and accessories for your princess.

zh-CN.title: 甜心公主换装记
zh-CN.description: 高颜值少女心爆棚甜心公主换装记：海量华丽礼服、梦幻发型与闪耀配饰自由搭配，打造专属二次元人气小公主！
